name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: Counts over two dimensions (weekday × hour, agent × day) as a keyboard-navigable grid of cells in five quintile steps of the single-series chart ink, with row and column headers, a tooltip per cell and an optional legend.

meta.whenToUse: Showing when or where activity concentrates across two dimensions — runs by weekday and hour, events by agent and day.
meta.whenNotToUse: A trend over one dimension (Chart), exact values people compare or sort (Table or DataList), or more than a few hundred cells.
